name: No unknown-context rejection spam (peer-selection)
description:
Workflow 4 of the #2422 regression test plan — covers options 3 + 4 from the issue (filter sync-target discovery by per-context subscription; typed NotMaterialized response).
Setup: a context exists on node-1; node-2 is in the same group but DELIBERATELY opted out of auto-follow (`auto_follow.contexts = false`). node-2 is therefore a legitimate namespace mesh peer that simply hasn't materialised the context. Today's sync-target selection in
  crates/node/src/sync/manager/mod.rs
treats namespace-mesh membership as good enough and picks node-2 as a sync target for the context. node-2 IS a verified group member in this topology (it was added via `add_group_members`), so the receiver-side gate sees `dialer_verified = true` and falls into the `materialised == None` arm, logging at DEBUG level:
  "context not materialised within join race window, closing stream"
(see crates/node/src/sync/manager/mod.rs — the materialisation window). The CI runner greps for that exact debug signature; the Ronit/Fran-shape warn ("inbound stream for unknown context") only fires when `dialer_verified = false`, which this workflow does NOT reproduce (would need a cross-namespace stream or a missing group_for_context mapping). Both signatures are guarded in CI so a future workflow that does provoke the warn shape is auto-covered.
Workflow shape:
  - bootstrap two-node namespace + subgroup
  - admin (node-1) auto-follows its own contexts and writes data
  - node-2 joins WITHOUT auto-follow being set on it
  - then we just sleep — letting normal gossipsub + sync-session
    timers run on their own. The bug manifests during that window:
    node-1's sync layer picks node-2 as a sync target and node-2's
    responder logs the rejection.

Pass/fail policy:
  - The convergence side is intentionally empty: by construction
    node-2 never materialises context-A, so no positive overlap
    assertion exists. Workflow steps are otherwise individually
    green on a healthy run.
  - The REGRESSION GATE is inline via merobox's
    `assert_log_absent` step (merobox#244) — a final step at the
    end of the workflow scans both nodes' docker logs for three
    signatures and fails the workflow on any hit:
      (a) "context not materialised within join race window"
          (debug-level — our topology's symptom)
      (b) "inbound stream for unknown context"
          (warn-level — Ronit/Fran shape, for future workflows
           that provoke !dialer_verified)
      (c) "no owned identities found for context"
    Same shape as sync-regression.yml's #2356 guards, but now
    expressed inline in the workflow file rather than as a CI-side
    grep on the artefact.
  - The metric counterpart
    (`sync_failures_total{protocol="HashComparison"}` on node-1
    should stay near zero for this context) is deferred until
    merobox grows an `assert_metric` step. The runtime-side
    plumbing already exists in
      crates/node/src/sync/prometheus_metrics.rs::sync_failures_total
    so adding it is a workflow-author change, not a core change.
  - The local-absent assertion on node-2 (no materialised entry for
    ctx-A) is deferred until merobox grows an
    `assert_context_absent` step. See the marked TODO at the end.
